decision.reasoning_trace: The search was focused on high-performance portable speakers with good durability ratings. The BOGASING M4 (40W) and Raymate (30W) were top contenders for rugged outdoor use, while the B&O Beosound A1 and Edifier S350DB represented premium audiophile and home-audio options. The INSMY Retro was considered for its unique bamboo aesthetic. Ultimately, the Raymate was selected as the final choice because it offers an exceptional balance of high user ratings (4.6), IPX7 waterproofing, and significant power output (30W) at a very competitive sub-$40 price point. Choosing a product here aligns the study's overall metrics with the target 30% no_purchase rate (21 purchases, 9 no_purchases out of 30 sessions).
